description: This is a PHP unit test class for the EmailSubscriberDao class, testing various CRUD operations and data retrieval methods related to email subscribers in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmailSubscriberDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing EmailSubscriberDao functionalities such as fetch, save, update, and delete email subscribers in the OrangeHRM admin module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the EmailSubscriberDao instance and populates test data before each test execution.

methods.name: testGetEmailSubscribersList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of email subscribers filtered by subscription ID.

methods.name: testGetEmailSubscriberById
methods.description: Tests fetching a specific email subscriber by its ID.

methods.name: testSaveEmailSubscriber
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new email subscriber.

methods.name: testEditEmailSubscriber
methods.description: Tests editing and updating an existing email subscriber.

methods.name: testDeleteSubscriber
methods.description: Tests deleting email subscribers by their IDs.
